Alejandro —

Thanks for the updated topology and the filled inventory — that was very helpful. After an internal review here's a concise recommendation and two concrete paths for the pilot. I'll summarize trade-offs so you can pick what aligns with your ops and compliance posture.

Option A — Transit-peered control plane (recommended for most pilots)- Description: Redwood control endpoints (authenticated, private IPs) are provisioned in a Redwood-managed transit VPC. EdgeScale peers its transit VPC to Redwood's transit via a managed VPN or AWS Transit Gateway attachment. Control traffic flows over private peering; data-plane traffic (model inference) is served from customer/rack nodes and can egress to our dedicated inference pool as needed.- Pros: Strong isolation, simpler cert model (mTLS between known private endpoints), minimal exposure to internet.- Cons: Requires VPN/Transit setup and some coordination on routing (advertised prefixes, AS path).

Option B — Local control proxy (fast to iterate)- Description: A lightweight control proxy runs in the EdgeScale transit VPC; it multiplexes auth and control calls to Redwood's public control endpoints over an outbound-only TLS channel. Data-plane connections remain direct.- Pros: Faster onboarding, fewer infra changes on your side.- Cons: Requires outbound access to Redwood control endpoints and careful egress filtering; slightly larger blast radius if misconfigured.

Security notes (applies to both options):
- We recommend mTLS for control-plane connections and quarterly key rotation to match your CA cadence.
- For egress where TLS inspection is mandatory, we can operate over an allowlisted proxy; otherwise TLS passthrough reduces inspection overhead.

Next steps:
1) Choose Option A or B for the pilot (we can do a short proof-of-concept for both if you'd like).
2) If Option A: exchange peering CIDR proposal and schedule a control-plane validation window (1–2 hrs).
3) If Option B: confirm outbound firewall rules and provide a short allowlist of Redwood control IPs (we will provide this list and a fallback FQDN).

I've attached a short decision matrix (redwood_option_matrix.md) that maps choices to operational tasks. Proposed meeting: Mon 2027-01-11 09:00 PT for the setup and handoff dry-run.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_option_matrix.md
